scope: Exhaustive finite meta-check over the declared two-pre/two-post-state universe; not a proof of the arbitrary finite theorem and not a protocol evaluation.

universe.good_terminals: every subset of actual post dead ends
universe.grant_options: none, t0, or t1 independently at each pre state
universe.initial_sets: all nonempty subsets of the two pre states
universe.pre_edge: p0->p1 absent, hidden, or visible a
